name: Lake of Reflection
source:
In a time of war and sorrow, will a stranger washed up upon the shore of a small isle find the answers to heal his heart? What of the gentle guardian who takes him into her care?

A story within a story. A narrator tells the tale of the last ice dragon and the water dragon who claimed his heart. How well does the listener take in the tale? Will the story be told to the end?
